title: Hosted API composite request funnel and escalation matrix for chat + streaming + tool calls
creator: Rina Patel
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers submit multi-modal Hosted API requests that combine chat, streaming, tool/function calls and structured outputs. Intake is inconsistent across channels, leading to delayed responses, misrouted work, unaccounted capacity impact, and missed SLA commitments.

Goal: Define a deterministic scoring funnel and escalation matrix that PMs, Solutions, and Support use to triage incoming Hosted API feature requests (non-bug). The funnel should: (1) surface enterprise risk signals, (2) estimate runtime/cost impact, (3) assign routing to Hosted/Dedicated/Private pathways, and (4) trigger security, legal, or infra escalations where required.

Scope: Customer feature requests (not incident/bug reports) that touch chat generation, streaming responses, tool/function calling, or structured outputs. Includes intake from Support, sales, CSMs, and self-serve forms. Excludes bug triage, billing disputes, and purely SDK-level requests.
proposal: 1) Create a lightweight scoring rubric with weighted signals: tenant size & SLA, PII/regulatory scope, request concurrency & streaming intensity, toolchain complexity (external integrations, webhooks), expected per-token delta, and customer business priority. 2) Implement a 3-tier routing decision: Hosted (default), Dedicated (if sustained high throughput or SLA), Private (regulatory/data residency). 3) Define explicit escalation triggers (security review, infra capacity planning, legal/compliance). 4) Produce a single-step intake form and internal triage UI in Console to capture signal values, plus a decision checklist for on-call PM/SEs. 5) Pilot with top 10 enterprise accounts for 6 weeks and iterate.
acceptance_criteria: A single documented scoring rubric exists and is reviewed by Security and Sales Engineering
An intake form template is created and used by Support and Solutions during pilot
Routing matrix maps score buckets to Hosted/Dedicated/Private with thresholds and rationale
Escalation playbook is documented with owners and SLA for response (24/48/72h tiers)
Pilot triage of at least 12 real customer requests with post-pilot retros completed
success_metrics: Reduce average triage turnaround time from 7d to <=48h for enterprise requests
Correct routing rate (requests routed to right deployment on first pass) >= 85%
Number of capacity surprises (unplanned Dedicated/Private provisioning) reduced by 60%
CSAT for intake experience >= 4.2/5 among pilot participants
open_questions: How to measure expected per-token cost delta reliably from customer-provided sample prompts?
What signal threshold should force an immediate infra capacity planning ticket to ENG?
Should Solutions Engineering be required to fill a technical checklist for all requests > P2?
Where is the right balance between automated scoring and human review to avoid false positives?
implementation_steps: Draft scoring rubric with weights and example scenarios (PM + SE + Security)
Build intake form and internal triage view in Console prototype (Product + Design)
Train Support and Solutions on rubric; run dry-run sessions with past requests
Run 6-week pilot with prioritized enterprise accounts; collect telemetry and feedback
Refine thresholds, publish final playbook, and add automation for routing notifications
